title: Black Squid Barossa Valley Shiraz Gin
description:
Pure and vibrant red in colour. Black Squid opens with the aromas of a classic Barossa Shiraz with lifted herbal and juniper characters. Delicate spice flavours mix with sweet fruits, fresh blueberries and raspberries; pepper spice with bittersweet chocolate and raisins finish the palate.

It's as unique a "gin" as you'll ever encounter.
serve: Neat, over ice, or with tonic and a few dark berries.
